title: 金字塔转换矩阵
summary: 底层字符串上方每个字符由下方相邻字符对按 allowed 三元组生成，判断能否逐层构造到单字符顶端。
insight: 把每个二字符底边映射到所有可选顶字符；对当前行从左到右回溯生成下一行，完成后递归处理下一层。
pitfalls: 同一字符对可能有多个顶字符选择
某位置没有允许转换时当前分支立即失败
长度一的底层已经成功

solutions.title: 逐层字符串回溯生成
solutions.idea: 预处理相邻对到顶字符列表，并搜索所有下一层组合。
steps: solve(row) 长度一返回真，否则 build(position,next)
build 对 row[position..position+1] 的所有候选追加字符；完成 next 时递归 solve(next)，成功立即返回

code.java: class Solution { private final Map<String,List<Character>> choices=new HashMap<>();public boolean pyramidTransition(String bottom,List<String> allowed){for(String rule:allowed)choices.computeIfAbsent(rule.substring(0,2),key->new ArrayList<>()).add(rule.charAt(2));return solve(bottom);}private boolean solve(String row){if(row.length()==1)return true;return build(row,0,new StringBuilder());}private boolean build(String row,int position,StringBuilder next){if(position==row.length()-1)return solve(next.toString());List<Character> options=choices.get(row.substring(position,position+2));if(options==null)return false;for(char c:options){next.append(c);if(build(row,position+1,next))return true;next.setLength(next.length()-1);}return false;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val choices=hashMapOf<String,MutableList<Char>>();fun pyramidTransition(bottom:String,allowed:List<String>):Boolean{for(rule in allowed)choices.getOrPut(rule.substring(0,2)){mutableListOf()}.add(rule[2]);return solve(bottom)};private fun solve(row:String):Boolean{if(row.length==1)return true;return build(row,0,StringBuilder())};private fun build(row:String,position:Int,next:StringBuilder):Boolean{if(position==row.length-1)return solve(next.toString());val options=choices[row.substring(position,position+2)]?:return false;for(c in options){next.append(c);if(build(row,position+1,next))return true;next.setLength(next.length-1)};return false} }
code.cpp: class Solution { unordered_map<string,vector<char>> choices;bool solve(string row){if(row.size()==1)return true;string next;return build(row,0,next);}bool build(string& row,int position,string& next){if(position==(int)row.size()-1)return solve(next);auto it=choices.find(row.substr(position,2));if(it==choices.end())return false;for(char c:it->second){next+=c;if(build(row,position+1,next))return true;next.pop_back();}return false;}public:bool pyramidTransition(string bottom,vector<string>& allowed){for(string& rule:allowed)choices[rule.substr(0,2)].push_back(rule[2]);return solve(bottom);} };
